title: Robust data-driven discovery of fractional differential equations via weak formulations and Pareto-based subset selection
abstract: arXiv:2608.12879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fractional partial differential equations describe nonlocal dynamics, but discovering them from noisy data is difficult because fractional differentiation amplifies high-frequency measurement noise and the derivative orders are unknown. We propose Weak-Pareto, which combines an adjoint-consistent weak formulation of fractional terms with Pareto-based subset selection over discrete term types and continuous fractional orders. For linear right-hand-side terms, the adjoint transfers fractional operators from measured fields to smooth test functions, replacing noise-sensitive pointwise differentiation with smoothing integration; for nonlinear terms, the noise-suppression effect is partial yet useful. Coefficients are fitted by ridge regression within a branch-aware differential-evolution search over the orders. The support size is then selected at the validation-error-complexity elbow. translated_title: 基于弱形式和帕累托子集选择的分数阶微分方程鲁棒数据驱动发现
translated_abstract: 分数阶偏微分方程描述了非局部动力学，但从含噪声数据中发现它们很困难，因为分数阶微分会放大高频测量噪声，且导数阶数未知。我们提出了Weak-Pareto方法，该方法将分数阶项的伴随一致弱形式与基于帕累托的子集选择相结合，涵盖离散项类型和连续分数阶。对于线性右侧项，伴随将分数算子从测量场转移到光滑测试函数，用平滑积分替代对噪声敏感的点微分；对于非线性项，噪声抑制效果部分但有用。系数通过岭回归在分支感知的差分进化搜索中拟合分数阶。然后，在验证误差-复杂度拐点处选择支持集大小。我们展示了固定线性右侧项的方差特性。
tldr: 本文提出Weak-Pareto方法，通过伴随一致的弱形式和帕累托子集选择，在噪声数据下鲁棒地发现分数阶微分方程，克服了分数阶微分放大噪声和阶数未知的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Weak-Pareto, which robustly discovers fractional differential equations from noisy data via adjoint-consistent weak formulations and Pareto-based subset selection, overcoming noise amplification and unknown derivative orders.
